up: Retrieve the first 1000 IC50 activity rows with pChEMBL values for the human single-protein target CHEMBL1741208 (NACHT, LRR and PYD domains-containing protein 3). Return assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value. Use only exact standard relation '=' rows with non-null pChEMBL values, and order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID.
sql:
WITH activities_with_pchembl AS (
    SELECT a.activity_id, a.assay_id, a.molecule_chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.pchembl_value, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.relation,
           ass.assay_id, ass.chembl_id, ass.assay_type, ass.tid, ass.assay_organism, ass.standard_inchi_key,
           target.pref_name AS target_pref_name, target.type AS target_type, target.tax_id AS tax_id,
           molpref.pref_name AS pref_name, mol.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
           struct.canonical_smiles
    FROM activities a
    JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
    JOIN target_dictionary target ON ass.tid = target.tid
    JOIN molecule_dictionary molpref ON a.molecule_chembl_id = molpref.chembl_id
    LEFT JOIN compound_structures struct ON molpref.molregno = struct.molregno
    WHERE a.standard_type = 'IC50'
      AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
      AND target.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1741208'
      AND target.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'
)
SELECT assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value
FROM activities_with_pchembl
ORDER BY molecule_chembl_id, assay_chembl_id
LIMIT 1000;
